summary: Today presents a mixed legal and retail docket driven by procedural court rulings on summary suits alongside notable corporate capital raises in the retail sector. Key highlights include high-value funding rounds by fashion brands and critical judicial precedents on consumer refunds and CPC proceedings.

bullets.text: Fashion retailer Style Union raised ₹485 crore in Series E funding led by Venturi Partners, expanding its footprint to 158 stores.
The J&K and Ladakh High Court held that post-decree deposits cannot retrospectively restore a defendant's forfeited right to defend Order 37 summary suits.
Reliance is planning a 1,600-satellite constellation network to challenge Starlink in offering satellite broadband services across India.
Visage Lines appointed former More Retail MD Vinod Nambiar as senior operating partner to oversee engineering, manufacturing, and appliance design.
NCDRC ruled allottees cannot be compelled to accept delayed flat possession, ordering a builder to refund ₹1.26 crore with 9% interest.
